subject: general
question: Which initiative will Prime Minister Narendra Modi launch to strengthen healthcare services for women and children across India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Swasth Nari Sashakt Parivar Abhiyaan**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Objective:** Strengthen healthcare services for women and children
 
• **Launch Date:** 17th of this month
 
• **Health Camps:** 75,000 camps at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, CHCs, and other facilities
 
• **Complementary Measure:** Poshan Maah observed at all Anganwadis to promote nutrition and health awareness

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Focuses on inclusive healthcare and empowered communities
 
• Encourages participation of private hospitals and healthcare stakeholders in the initiative
